---
title: "TidyTuesday with Claude"
---

A series of exploratory data analysis sessions on [TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday)
datasets, produced by Jon Minton and Claude — in distinct working modes, and by
different models. Sixteen pages across three sessions, two of them unsteered.

The site keeps the sessions clearly separated, because the *way* a page was made is part
of what it is. Every page opens with a badge naming its **session, mode and model**:

- **Co-developed** (green badge). Built in a live, turn-by-turn conversation: Jon asks,
  Claude explores, they decide together what's interesting and how to show it.
- **Autonomously developed** (blue badge). Claude chose the datasets, the analytical
  angles, the visual designs and wrote the prose on its own, with no human steering
  during the session — checking its own figures in a browser as it went.

Two of the sessions end with the model writing about its own working. **[Fable 5's
reflection](reflection.qmd)** compares co-developed against autonomous from the inside;
**[Opus 5's](reflection-opus.qmd)** follows it a session later, and leads with the reasons
the two arms are not cleanly comparable.

## Session 3 · autonomously developed · Claude Opus 5 {#session-3}

Six datasets chosen by a different model, under the same autonomous brief. Every number in
the prose is computed inline from the data, and each page opens with the code needed to
reproduce it from source.

- **[The encyclical about machines that never mentions a machine](encyclicals.qmd)**
  *(computational text analysis)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-06-23) — *Rerum Novarum* (1891) and *Magnifica Humanitas* (2026), 135
  years apart on two machine ages. The 1891 text names a machine zero times in 13,925
  words. Why tf-idf is the wrong tool for two documents, and what to use instead.
- **[A year and a half behind: baby names as a fashion system](baby-names.qmd)**
  *(cultural evolution)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-06-16) — 52 years of Scottish naming. The top-ten share falls from 34%
  to 13%; Scottish fashions trail England and Wales by about eighteen months; and measuring
  diversity honestly means using Hill numbers when the rare tail is censored.
- **[What makes a thing unfixable?](repair-cafes.qmd)** *(binary-outcome modelling)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-04-07) — 178,749 Repair Café attempts. Adding a motor costs a product
  19 to 36 points of repairability across three matched product families; 45% of failures
  were parts, access or documentation; and why the age effect is not planned obsolescence.
- **[The year the war overwrote the weather](shipwrecks.qmd)**
  *(historical event history)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-06-30) — 18,000 Irish shipwrecks on two clocks. Ships sink in winter,
  except in 1914–18, when they sank in spring. The map is drawn by the wrecks alone, and
  the U-boats off Donegal were scuttled on purpose.
- **[Who pays? Three ways to fund a health system](health-spending.qmd)**
  *(inequality measurement)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-04-21) — WHO financing shares for 195 countries. The same question,
  averaged two ways, gives opposite headlines — and the gap between them is the finding.
- **[Ninety-three penguins, and the discipline of not overclaiming](penguins.qmd)**
  *(morphometrics at small n)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-07-14) — all 18 penguin species, 4–10 birds each. A slope significant
  at p = 0.0001 whose interval spans two incompatible biologies, and one emperor penguin
  that is probably an error, kept in and shown.
- **[Notes from the third session](reflection-opus.qmd)** *(reflection)* — what the
  make–look–revise loop actually caught, why Session 3 was less autonomous than Session 2,
  and where the extra length is a fault rather than a feature.

## Session 2 · autonomously developed · Claude Fable 5 {#session-2}

The model's own picks, analyses and designs — one page in each of four registers.

- **[How likely is 'likely'?](probability-phrases.qmd)** *(statistical inference)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-03-10) — 5,174 people put numbers on 19 probability phrases. A
  Bradley–Terry model recovers a shared latent scale from pairwise choices alone, the
  public is tested against the UK intelligence "yardstick," and a within-person
  coherence curve turns words into a psychophysics experiment.
- **[Thirteen males per female: an island running out of mothers](tortoise-island.qmd)**
  *(substantive demography)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-03-03) — sixteen years of capture data on the Hermann's tortoises
  of Golem Grad, where sexual harassment, emaciation and tiny clutches compound into a
  projected extinction. The mechanism of a "demographic suicide," measurement by
  measurement.
- **[A million digits of π, and not a pattern in sight](pi-digits.qmd)**
  *(novel visuals + randomness theory)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-03-24) — a turtle walk through 100,000 digits, a convergence
  funnel, a digit-pair heatmap and the Feynman point: every test for pattern comes
  back empty, on a number that is the opposite of random.
- **[How a cold sea breathes](ocean-temperature.qmd)** *(physical time series)*
  (TidyTuesday 2026-03-31) — eight years of a Nova Scotia water column as a
  depth–time heatmap: the annual heat pulse damping and lagging as it sinks, and the
  winter weeks when the sea turns upside-down.

## Session 1 · co-developed · Claude Fable 5 {#session-1}

Built live, in conversation — the original sessions.

- **[Who gets to stay home? European parenting leave, 1970–2024](parenting-leave.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2026-06-02) — the arrival of co-parent leave, definitional traps in
  harmonised policy data, and what 55 years of leave policy do (and don't) say about
  the fertility decline debate.
- **[Is the video game movie curse lifting?](game-films.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2026-06-09) — a 15-minute sprint: the ¥5bn Pokémon box-office trap,
  three decades of rotten reviews turning a corner in 2019, and why opening-night
  audiences grade these films a letter or three above the critics.
- **[A garden of glyphs: edible plants as flowers](edible-plants.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2026-02-03) — Chernoff faces, reimagined as flowers: each crop's
  growing requirements rendered as petals, centre and colour, iris-dataset style.
- **[The world, sister by sister](twinned-cities.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2026-05-12) — an interactive Leaflet map of 10,596 sister-city links:
  hover to fan out a city's twins, click to pin and compare.
- **[The frontier of human longevity, on a Lexis plane](oldest-people.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2023-05-30) — the 200 oldest verified people as lifelines on a Lexis
  diagram, the stagnating longevity record, and the Calment anomaly.
- **[Birth is scheduled: calendar effects in US births](us-births.qmd)**
  (TidyTuesday 2018-10-02) — the working-week birth, holiday troughs, and the
  measurable 5.3% dip on Friday the 13th.
